acceptedAdvisories.title: uuid: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf is provided
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: The affected uuid 7 copy is pinned by xcode and is used only by the iOS prebuild toolchain; overriding across four major versions is not justified.

acceptedAdvisories.title: decode-uri-component: Denial of service via exponential decoding of malformed percent-encoded input
acceptedAdvisories.rationale: Expo Router's query-string dependency requires the vulnerable 0.2 line; crossing the pre-1.0 boundary needs a compatibility proof because route parsing is runtime-reachable.

protectedOverrides.rationale: The version-scoped override keeps minimatch 10 on brace-expansion's patched 5.0 line without forcing incompatible versions into older minimatch majors.
The version-selected override keeps js-yaml 4 above the patched floor without forcing its major version onto older consumers.
The version-selected override keeps Expo's 0.8 consumers above the XML fragment-injection advisory's patched floor without crossing a pre-1.0 boundary.
